interpretation: This is a DETERMINISTIC policy comparison on planted errors and known-correct answers. It is NOT a model-capability benchmark -- it compares verifier POLICIES, not model outputs. The 'raw-model' policy is a SIMULATED accept-everything baseline (no verifier), not a real model run. Only the 'proposed-system' policy executes the real deterministic verifier.

always-abstain.description: Abstains/rejects on every item. Fail-closed but zero coverage.

always-accept.description: Accepts every item. Same outcomes as raw-model; named for clarity.

proposed-system.description: The deterministic verifier (demo.verify_problem). Rejects planted errors, accepts correct SI/sympy answers, abstains on uncovered formal-proof items.

raw-model.description: SIMULATED accept-everything baseline (no verifier). Not a real model run; it is the trivial decision rule a verifier-less system degenerates to.
